description: Get token transfer events for an address, optionally filtered by token contract. Select the token standard: erc20 (fungible, default), erc721 (NFT), or erc1155 (multi-token).

chainid.description: Numeric chain id (e.g. 1=Ethereum, 56=BNB, 137=Polygon). If omitted, defaults to Ethereum Mainnet (1).

contractaddress.description: Token contract address to filter by.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Default 1. page x offset must be at most 10000; narrow the block range to see more.

sort.description: Sort order by block number. Default desc (newest first).

standard.description: Token standard: erc20 (default), erc721, or erc1155.

name: get_token_transfers

data.description: The JSON result returned by the Etherscan data tool.

title: Get Token Transfers
